review: 3 Community Stewards, scored against the DeGrants rubric
one_liner: Stacks DeFi has no honest instrumentation — so measure the depth, and give it away.
problem: Builders, LPs, treasuries, and the Endowment itself have no reproducible view of where liquidity actually is, how much of it is real, and whether it's growing or bleeding. Bitflow ships no public API; ALEX ships one, but you have to discover for yourself that most of its pools are dead; TVL headlines circulate with no methodology behind them. Everyone downstream is working from vibes.
public_good: Data plus method, given away, that no one currently provides — an open dataset, a daily depth index, and an on-chain beacon. It doesn't compete with ALEX, Bitflow, or Velar; it measures them, and makes their own numbers legible.
who_is_hurt: Anyone deciding whether to LP, deploy treasury capital, or build a protocol on Stacks — and the Endowment deciding where to fund.

milestones.title: Open the data
milestones.deliverable: Public repo + open dataset (per-pool, per-day TVL, real volume, fees, and a liveness flag across ALEX / Bitflow / Velar) + a documented, reproducible harness.

milestones.title: The instrument
milestones.deliverable: The Stacks depth index — how much capital can move, at what slippage, on which venue — plus the negative-edge study (published even when the answer is no) and a live public dashboard.

milestones.title: On-chain + the Clarity ramp
milestones.deliverable: A minimal read-only Clarity beacon publishing the daily index (no funds, no custody, no audit surface) + a written “porting a quant engine to Clarity, from zero” guide.

no_audit_line: No audit line — the design has no custody surface, so none is needed. That is exactly why $5,000 is a real budget here and not a down payment on something larger.
claims: Stacks market-structure numbers we measured ourselves on-chain, each with a cited source.
A reproducible harness — every published number regenerates bit-for-bit from the committed dataset.
A published negative-edge audit: a null result put in the open, not hidden.
does_not_claim: No Stacks traction — nothing is built on Stacks yet, and no Stacks users.
No Clarity experience — M3 is the ramp, and the write-up documenting it is itself a deliverable.
No alpha — our own audit says there is none, and we never imply otherwise.
No TVL, no users, no revenue.

self_correction.context: An earlier draft of the proposal cited ~$75k/day for the top ALEX pair — a raw token count read as dollars. Measured on-chain it is far thinner, which only strengthens the thesis. Publishing a correction downward is not what a grant-farmer does.
